description: Official host whitelist for the tutorial sources ledger. Every external link in a lesson body and every url in sources/<course>.json must use https and match one entry here. An entry matches a url whose hostname equals `host` exactly and, when `pathPrefixes` is present, whose path starts with one of them. Each entry names the tool whose official site it is. Adding a host means adding it here with its tool, and the host must be the tool's own site, not a mirror or a third-party guide.
